subject: Zukunft von Emir in der U12 — wir sind unsicher

triage.summary: Undecided father (in German) floats pausing a season, moving Emir (U12) to a squad with fewer training days, or cancelling the membership at season end and asks for a recommendation — an exit decision that needs a human — and also asks what happens to the already-paid contribution (potential refund).
triage.proposed_action: Human board decision required (exit decision): no binding commitments in auto-reply; propose a phone call as requested and present options neutrally (season pause, switch to squad with fewer training days via coach, cancellation at season end) plus clarify what happens to the already-paid contribution (refund check); coordinate with U12 coach on training load before any exit step.

details.fee_question: Was passiert mit dem bereits bezahlten Beitrag bei Kündigung (potenzielle Rückerstattung)?
details.flags_note: Undecided family; fatigue of child likely commute-related, no health condition stated — verify by phone
options_raised: Wechsel in Mannschaft mit weniger Trainingstagen
details.situation: Vater beruflich im Umbruch seit April, pendelt 3x/Woche nach Stuttgart; Emir manchmal erst 18:30 Uhr zuhause und erschöpft, sagte zweimal 'Fußball macht keinen Spaß mehr' — Vater vermutet Überlastung durch lange Tage, nicht Verlust des Interesses
